items.name: theme
items.title: Forge Workspace theme
items.description: Tokens (colours, tones, statuses, console, diff), Geist, the compact type scale, radii, elevation, orb utilities, focus ring, scrollbars and reduced motion.

@utility bg-orb-workspace.background: radial-gradient(at 15% 15%, #86e5ef 0, transparent 55%), radial-gradient(at 20% 90%, #ffb65d 0, transparent 65%), radial-gradient(at 100% 10%, #5f7fdc 0, transparent 55%), conic-gradient(from 80deg, #a4dcad, #9d7ace, #f1a3c0, #67b6d7, #a4dcad)

@utility shimmer.background-image:
linear-gradient(
        90deg,
        currentColor 35%,
        color-mix(in oklab, currentColor 30%, transparent) 50%,
        currentColor 65%
    )
